name: When should a defense attorney withdraw from a case?

mainEntity.name: When should a defense attorney withdraw from a case?

acceptedAnswer.text: A defense attorney should withdraw if they cannot provide quality representation, face a conflict of interest, or lack the expertise or resources needed for your specific case.nlada​
